name: app-green-fintech-wallet-phone-on-ghost-lettering
title: Green Fintech Wallet on Ghost Lettering
whatItIs: A tilted phone with a dark wallet UI, green VISA card, big balance and a lime Send Money button, against a green gradient grid with giant translucent lettering.
whatItMeans: Lime on dark and green gradient signals fresh, growth-oriented money. Ghost letters add depth.
techniques: Giant faint brand letters behind the device
Lime CTA as the only bright element on dark UI
Card visual matching the backdrop gradient
Fine grid lines in the background
bestFor: Brands with a bold green identity

vocabulary.definition: Oversized low-contrast text behind a subject.
A device rotated in space for dynamism.
A neon yellow-green used sparingly for actions.
